title: Summarize 50 log files into one line each
prompt: The directory logs/ contains app_00.log through app_49.log. For each of those files, count the lines that contain ERROR (case-sensitive). Write the result to errors.txt: one line per log file in the form <filename> <count>, where <filename> is the bare file name without the logs/ directory prefix, ordered by file name ascending. Write nothing else.
